text:
Maria L.: Heads-up — ran into an SDK vs REST parity bug while trying to send batched embeddings. REST supports sending multiple inputs in one call but the Node SDK rejects the payload.

Maria L.: Minimal repro (works via REST):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1","inputs":["a","b","c"]}'
```

Maria L.: Same intent in SDK (fails):
```js
// @redwood/sdk v0.9.2
const r = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await r.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embedding-1', input: ['a','b','c'] });
// SDK throws: Error: invalid input type, expected string
```

Alex G.: :eyes: Can you paste the stack trace / response body? Also which language? node?

Maria L.: Node, confirmed. Response from SDK wrapper: `400 invalid_request: invalid input type`. Network trace shows SDK doing POST /v1/embeddings with JSON `{ "input": "[object Object]" }` (looks like it coerced the array). REST bulk endpoint is `/v1/embeddings/bulk` and expects `inputs` array.

Sanjay R.: Hmm that sounds like a surface mismatch. SDK client probably wraps the single-input endpoint and stringifies arrays. Could be an oversight when we changed REST routes to add the bulk endpoint. Which client version? v0.9.2?

Maria L.: Yes v0.9.2. Also noticed different retry behavior: when REST returns 429 + Retry-After, direct REST callers pause; SDK automatically retries (no exposed hook) and we ended up with double work on the backend and extra tokens billed.

Jen T.: Workaround: call REST directly until SDK fix lands. Quick fetch example: 
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'open-embedding-1', inputs: myArray })
});
```

DevOps Bot: rate-limiter: counter for api_key=* increased by 3 on 1798123462, returned 429 Retry-After: 6s

Alex G.: I'll take this. Plan: (1) add a thin `embeddings.bulk()` method in the Node SDK that calls `/v1/embeddings/bulk` and preserves the `inputs` array shape; (2) update the SDK's retry middleware to honor `Retry-After` (and surface a retry hook); (3) add e2e test that posts a 3-item batch and asserts no coercion.

Sanjay R.: Sounds good. Also file a GH issue linking this thread and add `regression: sdk-parity` tag. We should add a lightweight integration test in the sdk-integration CI matrix against the hosted API.

Maria L.: I will open the issue and add my repro snippets. For the short term I'll use the REST workaround in the sample apps.

Alex G.: I'll PR the SDK change and ping @eng-runtime to confirm the bulk endpoint semantics (path, body keys). Anyone want to review?

Jen T.: I can review the docs update for the sample app to include the REST example and a note about Retry-After.

Maria L.: Thanks all :raised_hands: — created issue with links and marked as blocker for the sample-app onboarding flow.
